notes.title: Achievement update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have some news to share with you regarding the game's achievements. We've recently made some updates to ensure that all achievements are fairly obtainable within the game. Regrettably, one achievement isn't earnable through typical gameplay, so developers had to add it manually time after time.

To maintain fairness for all players, we heavy-heartedly decided to remove this achievement. We understand this may be disappointing news for some of you, but be sure we are constantly striving to improve your gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Various optimisations and fixes
notes.content:
This application is updated regularly to improve its functions and features. The current version includes a range of optimizations and bug fixes designed to improve performance and stability.
Added MacOS 64bit support.

notes.title: Adam Wolfe update has just been released!
notes.content:
The biggest news is that the game is now localized into Dutch (in addition to English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Serbian).

Also, all the issues that stopped you from running the game smoothly are resolved!

Have fun playing Adam Wolfe!

notes.title: Adam Wolfe’s second episode download issues resolved!
notes.content:
Adam Wolfe’s second episode “The Devil you Know” download issues have been resolved. 

Those who have bought the season pass (episodes 2-4) and the complete season (episodes 1-4) can now play it without any troubles. 

Important notice:

- When buying the season pass, in order to unlock all episodes, one must purchase Adam Wolfe’s first episode “The Ancient Flame”, available for $5.99, €5.99, £4.99.

Third and fourth episodes will be available on October 21st and November 4th.

notes.title: Adam Wolfe lands on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]We are thrilled to announce that Adam Wolfe, our new IP in the Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure genre, will launch its first two episodes “The Ancient Flame” and “The Devil You Know” on October 7th. [/h1]

Supernatural investigator Adam Wolfe deals with the shadows of his past while solving mysterious cases in the seedy underbelly of San Francisco in this Neo-noir adventure game that offers unique puzzles, a gripping story, incredible hand-drawn art, action set-pieces and a cinematic quality to the Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure genre.

Haunted by the disappearance of his sister, Adam struggles with his own demons as he investigates occult crimes, supernatural occurrences and the horrific reality of San Francisco crime syndicates. As players solve the mysteries before them, they slowly unravel a conspiracy that could lead Adam to his missing sibling, but simultaneously drag him down into the dark abyss of the city, forever. Use your wits, your detective instincts and, when all else fails, your six-shooter in this psychological thriller packed with challenging gameplay. Secret societies, unnatural afflictions and ancient covenants await in Adam Wolfe's pulse pounding four episodes.

The game features an English voiceover and is fully localized in English, French, German, Russian, simplified Chinese and Serbian.

Become the detective. Become Wolfe.
